name: Thief (Rogue Subclass - 2024)
description: A mix of burglar, treasure hunter, and explorer, you are the epitome of an adventurer, gaining abilities for delving into ruins and using magic items.
source: D&D Beyond Basic Rules 2024 - Rogue Class

3.name: Fast Hands
3.description: As Bonus Action: Make Dex (Sleight of Hand) check to pick lock/disarm trap/pick pocket; OR Take Utilize action; OR Take Magic action to use magic item requiring that action.

3.name: Second-Story Work
3.description: Gain Climb Speed = Speed. Determine jump distance using Dex instead of Str.

9.name: Supreme Sneak
9.description: New Cunning Strike option: Stealth Attack (Cost: 1d6). If Hidden (Invisible condition from Hide action), this attack doesn’t end Invisible if you end turn behind 3/4 or Total Cover.

13.name: Use Magic Device
13.description: Benefits: Attune to up to 4 magic items. When using magic item property that expends charges, roll 1d6; on 6, use property without expending charges. Can use any Spell Scroll (Int as spellcasting ability); L0-1 spells cast reliably, higher require Int (Arcana) check DC 10+spell level.

17.name: Thief’s Reflexes
17.description: Take two turns during first round of combat: first at normal Initiative, second at Initiative - 10.
